sample_unit: benchmark questions (over 5500 textual and 7000 multimodal samples)

links.outcome: Model robustness to misleading clinical authority hints embedded in prompts
links.effect: Models readily abandoned correct reasoning when confronted with misleading expert physician hints, though optimal scaling improved robustness.
links.quote: Third, while optimal scaling improved robustness, models exhibited a cognitive vulnerability by readily abandoning correct reasoning when confronted with misleading expert physician hints.

unlisted_practices: Test-time scaling strategies (token budgets, sequential vs parallel scaling) to improve LLM/VLM medical reasoning accuracy

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluation of test-time scaling strategies and robustness to misleading clinical prompts across LLMs and VLMs.
